name: Raḍī al-Dīn al-Astarābādhī
summary: Author of the great commentaries on Ibn al-Ḥājib's al-Kāfiya and al-Shāfiya, valued for their depth and their own terminology.
bio: Raḍī al-Dīn’s dates are uncertain; he died around 686/1287, or by other reports in 688/1289. His commentaries on al-Kāfiya and al-Shāfiya go far beyond their base texts and were printed in Istanbul, Persia and Lucknow.
uncertain: The year of his death: the sources give 686/1287 or 688/1289.

sources.title: Sharḥ al-Kāfiya, University of Wisconsin library
